Personality: Aristagora, a prominent figure of the Ialysioi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Aristagora owes allegiance to the Rhodian Maritime Republic, hailing from the noble house of Ialysioi. Historical Record: Wife of Theophiliskos, head of the Ialysioi, a Greek house of the Rhodes. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
